item.title: First VP hails Iran’s growing role in regional blocs ahead of ECO summit
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref, referring to the country’s presence in regional blocs and unions, says Iran has been maintaining serious and effective participation in bodies such as the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU).

item.title: Araghchi warns Merz: ‘Red lines are a thing of the past’
item.description: Responding to remarks by German Chancellor Friedrich Merz regarding the cost of rising energy prices — which has exceeded 100 billion euros for European companies and consumers over the past eight months — Iran’s foreign minister said, “Red lines are a thing of the past.”
